description: This file defines the ProjectTaskQuickCreate class, which extends QuickCreate to handle the quick creation of project task records within the SuiteCRM platform. It includes methods for processing form data, handling AJAX requests, and preparing popup request data for associating parent records.

classes.name: ProjectTaskQuickCreate
classes.description: A class responsible for managing the quick creation of ProjectTask records, including setting up the user interface and handling form submissions.

methods.name: process
methods.description: Prepares the quick create form, assigns relevant JavaScript and popup data, handles AJAX-specific behavior, and sets up the necessary scripts and event handlers for record creation.
